tell: Check the brown and white identification label on the bottom left side of the heater; model numbers begin with 18, 25, or 30 followed by four numbers ending in series A or B.

product: Columbia Industrial fiberglass extension ladders
title: Industrial Fiberglass Extension Ladders Recalled by Keller
tell: Check the brand name, model number, color, and manufacturing dates on the product label.

product: Americas Nature Company Folk Art wooden armadillos
title: Wooden Armadillo and Turtle Recalled by Americas Co.
tell: All units are recalled. They can be identified by a sticker on the bottom that reads 'Hecho En Mexico' or a hang tag reading 'Folk Art The Nature Company'.

product: Black & Decker hedge trimmers

tell: Check the second line of the product identification label on the right hand side for TR135 Type 1, TR195 Type 1, or TR255 Type 1.

product: Meri-Jon Artist Colony zippered bean bag chairs

product: Baby Bucky baby pillows

product: Shindaiwa backpack blowers

tell: Check for model number EB-45 printed on the white fuel tank of the backpack blower, or model number 300S printed on the pull-start housing of the red chain saw.

product: CPSC, Ryobi And Sears Announce Table Saw Switch Recall For Repair
title: CPSC, Ryobi And Sears Announce Table Saw Switch Recall For Repair
tell: Ryobi saws with serial numbers ending in four digits lower than 9608 and all Sears Craftsman Model 315.22185 saws are recalled. The serial number is on a data plate on the right side.

product: Juicer Tiger electric juicers

tell: Check the underside of the base for model numbers 204-SP or JE-1000; the program excludes model 160, units made in France, and those sold in retail stores.

product: Dollar Tree stationery activity sets

product: CPSC And Bill's Dollar Stores Recall Electric Hair Dryers
title: CPSC And Bill's Dollar Stores Recall Electric Hair Dryers
tell: All units are recalled. The hair dryers were labeled either International Professional Styler or Acesonic Professional Styler.

product: NuTone Stereo-Cassette Players
title: CPSC, Nutone Announce Stereo-Cassette Player Recall
tell: The words NuTone and the model number appear on the front of the radio to the left of the radio dial.

product: CPSC, Division Sales Announce Wooden Caterpillar Recall
title: CPSC, Division Sales Announce Wooden Caterpillar Recall
tell: All units are recalled. The toy is unlabeled but comes in a blue cardboard box labeled Wood Caterpillar Item No. 801 Made in China For Justen Products.

product: Scott Unishock Ultimate, Team/Comp Racing, Unitrack suspension forks

tell: Recalled forks have the SCOTT logo and a sticker reading UNISHOCK with the designation S, LF, VR, TX or R; white forks with UNISHOCKS are not included.

product: Charter Oak above ground pool frame ledge covers

product: CPSC And Zip Zag Announce Sweat Shirt Recall
title: CPSC And Zip Zag Announce Sweat Shirt Recall
tell: You can tell the recalled sweatshirts by the hang tag reading Style 133033 Red Cabin and the sewn-in neck label reading Red Cabin RN 65313 Made in Pakistan.

product: O'Neill Milky Way jackets

tell: All units of this jacket are recalled; check the neck label for O'Neill, RN 85773, and 100% Cotton, or the chest embroidery.

product: Lidco Big Wooden Truck toys
title: CPSC And Everything's A Dollar Announce Toy Truck Recall
tell: All units are recalled. Each toy is labeled LIDCO, North York, Ontario Canada with SKU 58188 and UPC number 0 59584 05230 1.

product: Binky Griptight Newborn Orthodontic Pacifiers

tell: Recalled pacifiers have red, mint green, blue, and white butterfly-shaped shields with 1/4 inch knob wells and a fixed knob. The item numbers 2115, 3085, 3086, and 3087 are on the front package.

product: White-Rodgers natural gas water heater temperature controls
title: CPSC, White-Rodgers Announce Gas Water Heater Temperature Control Recall
tell: Check the white label on the right side of the metal box for a model number starting with 37, and the date code 9412 to 9440 on the back.

product: Berko baseboard heaters

tell: Affected heaters have model numbers beginning with MBB, followed by four numbers, and ending in M. The silver label is on the right side inside the heater.

product: Crosley chest freezers

tell: All units of the named chest freezers are not recalled; contact the manufacturer with your brand, model, and serial number located on the plate on the front inside wall on the right side or the outside back wall.

product: CPSC, Kmart Corporation Announce Shirt Recall
title: CPSC, Kmart Corporation Announce Shirt Recall
tell: All units are recalled. You can identify them by the sewn-in neck label with RN 42000 and NORTHWEST TERRITORY, and hang tags with style number 8025 and item number 8311.

product: Silverwood, Manco above ground pool frame ledge covers

product: CPSC, Tuesday Morning Inc. Announce Cobbler Bench Toy Recall
title: CPSC, Tuesday Morning Inc. Announce Cobbler Bench Toy Recall

title: CPSC, Ridgewood Inc., And Charleswood Inc. Announce Warning On Cosco Youth Options Chifferobe, Four-Drawer Dresser
tell: Check the model number to see if it is 80813, 88813, 80413, or 88413.

product: Sinostone Accusniffer SC-01 carbon monoxide (CO) detectors

tell: All units are recalled. You can identify the recalled detector by the model number SC-01 and company name on a sticker on the back.

product: Braun Espresso/Cappuccino Makers

tell: Check the bottom of the base for type 3058 and production codes 426 through 450.

product: Atlas portable halogen indoor/outdoor work lights

product: Astro-Lounger recliner chairs

product: Makita Angle Grinder power tools

product: Toddle Tots Dinosaur Mountain playsets

tell: All Toddle Tots Dinosaur Mountain playsets are included in this recall.

product: Moose security control panels used with smoke detectors

tell: Check the model number and date code on the inner connect label inside the main panel door to see if it matches the recalled models and date codes.

product: Cosmic bicycle wheels for road bikes

product: CPSC And International Silver Company Recall Holiday Candle Holder

product: Ariens leaf blowers

product: REI Novara Ponderosa mountain bikes

product: Engineering Truck Educational Toys
title: CPSC, Division Sales, Inc. Announce Wooden Toy Truck Recall

product: Great Motherhood Squeak Kangaroo and baby kangaroo toys
title: CPSC, Accoutrements Announce Squeak Toy Recall
tell: You can identify the recalled toys by checking the item number S877 for the pickle toy or 9394 for the kangaroo and baby kangaroo set.

product: Gymboree GymRattle infant rattles

product: Technium FT 500 bicycle frames

tell: Check the serial number on the bottom bracket of the frame; recalled units have the number 3 as the sixth digit from the left.

product: CPSC And Godinger Recall Holiday Candle Holder
title: CPSC And Godinger Recall Holiday Candle Holder
tell: Check the item number on the product to see if it is model 1753 (silver-plated) or 1753B (brass-plated).

product: AT&T ACH-4U Nokia cellular phone chargers

product: CPSC, Consolidated Stores Announce Mini-Hammock Recall

product: Quality Craft wooden bunk beds

product: CiG disposable cigarette lighters

product: Come Play Junior Pro Basketball Set nets

product: Cosco full-size cribs

product: Charpente Classic Winnie the Pooh pull toys

tell: Check for model numbers 65301, 65302, 65303, 65304, or 65305, and a stamp on the bottom reading Classic POOH Charpente Designs.

product: LaNacional Cama Cuna No. 2 baby cribs

product: Imperial Aqua Wind Ups swimming animal toys
title: CPSC, Imperial Toy Corporation Announce Toy Recall
tell: All units are recalled except for the Benjie the Beaver aquatic toy.

product: Brinkmann Smoke'N Pit cookers

product: Dyna-Glo kerosene heaters

product: Munchkin Crayola glitter pacifiers

product: Gas Sniffer carbon monoxide detectors

product: Superyard children's play enclosures

product: CPSC, Paragon Racing Products, Inc. Announce Recall Of Ground Effects Tire Traction Compound
title: CPSC, Paragon Racing Products, Inc. Announce Recall Of Ground Effects Tire Traction Compound

product: City-Lites disposable cigarette lighters

product: Safety 1st Bed Rail and Flashlight

product: Trident screw-in DIN Tank Valve Caps

product: Modern Maid single gas wall ovens

product: Goula children's Sewing Boards

product: Teenage Mutant Ninja foam chairs

product: CTC Sixty Second Grill Express Grills

product: MTC television sets

product: AAA Electronics electric hand-held hair dryers

product: Porter-Cable Circular Saw power tools

product: CPSC, Matsushita Electric Corporation Of America Announce Panasonic Computer Printer Recall
title: CPSC, Matsushita Electric Corporation Of America Announce Panasonic Computer Printer Recall
tell: Check the model number on the front of the printer to the left of the on/off indicator lights; inspected units have a colored dot on the underside and on the box.

product: Raz Imports Christmas angel candlestick holders

tell: Check the model number and white label with the Raz Imports name located on the bottom of the holder under the angel's skirt.

product: CPSC, Winner Products, Inc. Announce Emergency Light Recall
title: CPSC, Winner Products, Inc. Announce Emergency Light Recall
tell: Check for model number 334N and the words EMERGENCY LITE 3-IN-1 HomeSafe on the front of the white plastic unit.

product: Playskool 1-2-3 High Chairs

tell: All units of the Playskool 1-2-3 High Chair are included in this recall.

product: Maytag dishwashers

product: Milwaukee Mag series sander/grinders

tell: Check the nameplate catalog number 6148 or 6151 on the label located on top of the tool, or packaging catalog numbers on the box.

product: Gerry Fold-Away Baby Cribs

tell: Check the model series 8200, 8300, or 8500 and the date code on a label attached to the crib's hinged mattress support.
